universal.name: Polished
universal.description: Professional balance for any musical genre
universal.tooltip: Balanced chain: transparent EQ, gentle compression (1.5:1), and limiting at -14 LUFS. Ideal when unsure which preset to pick — preserves original mix intent.

fuego.name: Brutal
fuego.description: Aggressive compression and maximum punch for modern beats
fuego.tooltip: Heavy compression (5:1) with +3dB transient boost and subtle saturation. Masters at -12 LUFS with -1dB ceiling, streaming-safe maximum: hot in trap and drill without distortion.

claridad.name: Crystal
claridad.description: Extreme brightness and stereo width for pop vocals and mixes
claridad.tooltip: EQ with +4dB top-end brightness, 6ms Haas delay for stereo width, and gentle compression (2:1). Perfect for pop vocals that need to shine above the mix.

cinta.name: Vintage
cinta.description: Analog tape-style harmonic saturation with vintage warmth
cinta.tooltip: Second-order harmonic saturation (+3dB drive, +4dB warmth) simulating analog tape. Gentle compression (2:1) with -1.5dB ceiling for rich warmth.

natural.name: Raw
natural.description: Minimal processing, organic dynamics and pristine transparency
natural.tooltip: Near-transparent compression (1.5:1) with conservative -2dB ceiling. Minimal saturation, zero Haas delay. Preserves natural dynamics for acoustic and live tracks.

espacial.name: Immersive
espacial.description: Ultra-wide stereo image with Haas delay for lush soundscapes
espacial.tooltip: Maximum stereo width (1.8x) with 15ms Haas delay creating an immersive soundstage. +2dB brightness and gentle compression (2:1) for synths and ambient pads.

cinematico.name: Epic
cinematico.description: Deep sub-bass impact, massive weight for live guitars and acoustic drums
cinematico.tooltip: Heavy punchy compression (5:1) with low-end boost and rich mid presence. Masters at -12 LUFS with cinematic impact and analog warmth.

empuje.name: Wall
empuje.description: Maximum loudness with heavy bass impact for urban tracks
empuje.tooltip: Ultra-competitive loudness (-12 LUFS / -1dBTP) with tight low-end and relentless compression (6:1) for clubs and urban hits.

pulido.name: Polished
pulido.description: Modern tonal balance, smooth top-end and controlled low-end

brutal.name: Brutal
brutal.description: Maximum punch, extreme commercial loudness and upfront presence

cristalino.name: Crystalline
cristalino.description: Airy highs, wide stereo image and acoustic transparency

vintage.name: Vintage
vintage.description: Subtle analog warmth, tape-style harmonic saturation and rich mids

crudo.name: Raw
crudo.description: Preserved organic dynamics, zero over-compression, direct character

envolvente.name: Immersive
envolvente.description: Deep spatial dimension, cinematic stereo imaging and dense bass

epico.name: Epic
epico.description: Deep sub-bass impact, massive weight for trailers and electronic tracks

muro.name: Wall
muro.description: Ultra-competitive loudness with no audible distortion for clubs

hero.title: Mastering is no longer an obstacle.
hero.titleGradient: Let sound awaken from the great beyond.
hero.description: 13-stage real-time spectral processing architecture. We eliminate dimensional flatness from your mixes through timbral intelligence, Haas psychoacoustic balance, and quantum fidelity.

philosophy.title: Sound Phenomenology of Brik
philosophy.subtitle: Understanding audio not merely as voltage oscillations, but as a living spectrum inhabiting multiple dimensions simultaneously.

card1.title: The Ghost of the Flat Mix
card1.desc: Conventional mixes perish in two-dimensional boxes, suffocated by choked transients and misaligned sub-bass. Brik resurrects dynamic micro-contrast, restoring the organic breathing room that generic limiters flatten.

card2.title: Decorrelated Mid/Side
card2.desc: The center channel preserves the punch of the kick drum and lead vocal, while lateral sides expand spectrally without inducing phase cancellation in mono club sound systems.

card3.title: Beyond-the-Grave Validation
card3.desc: Every rendering undergoes spectro-temporal analysis simulating 14 real-world playback environments: from studio monitors to smartphone speakers and massive festival compression transducers.

abPlayer.title: A/B Comparator: Original vs Brik Master
abPlayer.subtitle: Experience real-time psychoacoustic enhancement. Toggle between the unmastered mix and the finished result processed by our 13-stage engine.
abPlayer.statusBrik: BRIK HARMONIC SATURATION ENGAGED (+2.8 dB AIR)

chain.title: 13-Stage DSP Architecture
chain.subtitle: Every audio sample traverses a modular chain with zero destructive phase alteration. Click any module to inspect internal parameters, sub-stages, and tensors in real time.
chain.pipelineBadge: RUST SIMD PIPELINE: ZERO INTERSAMPLE LEAK

presets.title: Phantasmal Presets of Brik
presets.subtitle: Timbral profiles calibrated to channel precise sonic aesthetics with a single click in the console.

preset1.title: Spectral Polish
preset1.desc: Enhances top-end air presence and clears mud around 250Hz. Ideal for high-tempo electronic productions.

preset2.title: Brutal Transmutation
preset2.desc: Pushes loudness to the competitive club threshold (-9 LUFS) while preserving the dry impact of 808 sub-bass without dynamic choking.

preset3.title: Otherworldly Crystalline
preset3.desc: Extreme dimensional stereo imaging expansion. Transforms ethereal synths and orchestral strings into an immersive 360-degree sonic experience.

preset4.title: Vintage Ectoplasm
preset4.desc: Injected even-harmonic saturation through British console transformers and gentle optical compression with an organic, warm character.

founders.title: The Technical Coven — Brik Founding Team
founders.subtitle: The 3 minds uniting acoustic science, neural algorithms, and software engineering to master with spectral fidelity.

brikman.name: Brikman Paul Morales Lancheros
brikman.role: AUDIO SOFTWARE ARCHITECT & FULL STACK DEVELOPER
brikman.bio: Software engineer and lead creator of the mixing and mastering ecosystem. Specialist in the convergence of DSP and AI, pairing 10 years as a music producer with a proven track record in full-stack engineering and cloud architectures.
brikman.quote: “Transforming bytes into frequencies: where artificial intelligence sculpts the future of professional sound.”

miguel.name: Miguel Angel Ariza
miguel.bio: Artificial Intelligence Engineer focused on acoustic neural analysis and predictive modeling. Architect of the auditory intelligence algorithms powering the AudioMind engine, with extensive expertise in deep learning, generative neural architectures, and ultra-low-latency DSP inference pipelines.
miguel.quote: “Artificial intelligence does not replace musical emotion; it grants millimeter precision so it can transcend.”

andres.name: Andrés Villanueva Tabares
andres.bio: FullStack Engineer with over 7 years of experience designing, leading, and deploying high-concurrency web platforms and high-impact enterprise projects. Specialist in reactive frontend architectures and high-performance distributed services.
andres.quote: “Bridging both worlds: fluid and intuitive frontend interfaces backed by the strength and scale of a high-performance backend.”
